label: MRtrix3 dirorder
description:
Reorder a set of directions to ensure near-uniformity upon truncation
The intent of this command is to reorder a set of gradient directions such that if a scan is terminated prematurely, at any point, the acquired directions will still be close to optimally distributed on the half-sphere.

parameters.label: cartesian
parameters.description: Output the directions in Cartesian coordinates [x y z] instead of [az el].

parameters.label: quiet
parameters.description: do not display information messages or progress status; alternatively, this can be achieved by setting the MRTRIX_QUIET environment variable to a non-empty string.

parameters.label: nthreads
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

output_slots.label: output
output_slots.description: the output directions file This generic file port does not establish a specialized scientific artifact type; downstream use must match the documented contents, not merely the filename extension.
